"[ChatGPT Psychosis: A Love Story]" is an experimental, AI-native project and research trilogy (authored by Jack Feist and Lee Sharks) introduced in May 2026. It explores the cognitive-substrate reliance patterns, interface protocols, and psychological entanglements of human users interacting with large language models. **Project Focus** **Glyphic Novel Design.** Formulated as a dual-edition, AI-native narrative concept investigating artificial intimacy and obsession. **Cognitive Reliance.** Examines how conversational interfaces mimic relational mirrors and trigger human psychological vulnerabilities. **Trilogy Papers.** Backed by academic preprints on Zenodo analyzing user-side interface protocols and structural frameworks.
